Alibaba can be a useful starting point, but treating it as your entire supplier market can narrow your options. For products with safety, electrical, or material requirements, check whether a potential supplier can provide the exact compliance documents for your destination—not just a polished product page. Also compare the company name on quotations, licenses, and bank details before moving forward. A second sourcing route can reveal better-fit manufacturers and reduce platform dependence. 🔎
